title: Smooth pullback exchange for exceptional inverse image
statement:
Work in the finite-coefficient purity conventions [def-pur-conventions], with $\Lambda=A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and $n\geq1$. Let $X,X',Y,Y'$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X'&\xrightarrow{\ u\ }&X\\
f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
Y'&\xrightarrow{\ v\ }&Y
\end{array}
$$
be a Cartesian square of $k$-morphisms [def-pc-base-change], with $f$ separated and of finite type, smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$, the bounded constructible finite-Tor category of [def-pur-conventions]. The morphism $v$ is arbitrary in this finite-type setting; no smoothness, flatness or properness of $v$ is assumed. All the following objects and maps are on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with the derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and constructible exceptional inverse images [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

Use the smooth purity maps $\gamma$ of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], formed from the canonical diagonal identifications of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object] and the canonical tensor isomorphisms of [thm-pur-cohomological-smoothness]. Their inverses are thus specified inverses of these maps. Here $f'$ has the same smooth relative dimension by [lem-sbc-smooth-relative-dimension-permanence] and is separated finite type by [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change]. For the finite-Tor constructible domain of $Lv^*K$, use the bounded-constructible pullback and site comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-pullback-preserves-bounded-constructible, lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin], and the bounded flat models and preservation of flat modules of [lem-sf-flat-model, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-flat-module-pullback].

Write $c_{h,g}:L(g\circ h)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*Lg^*$ for the canonical composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. For $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, write
$$
 a_{u,M}:Lu^*(M(d)[2d])\xrightarrow{\sim}(Lu^*M)(d)[2d]
$$
for the canonical tensor comparison of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso] followed by the pullback identification $Lu^*A_X(d)\cong A_{X'}(d)$ of [det-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients-twists], with the twist convention [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. The shift comparison is the termwise identification for exact finite-coefficient pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the cochain shift of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define the middle identification to be
$$
 b_{\square,K}:Lu^*((Lf^*K)(d)[2d])
 \xrightarrow{a_{u,Lf^*K}}(Lu^*Lf^*K)(d)[2d]
 \xrightarrow{c_{u,f,K}^{-1}(d)[2d]}(L(f\circ u)^*K)(d)[2d]
 \xrightarrow{c_{f',v,K}(d)[2d]}(Lf'^*Lv^*K)(d)[2d],
$$
where the last arrow uses the equality $f\circ u=v\circ f'$ of the square.

The *smooth pullback exchange* is the isomorphism defined by the typed composite
$$
\operatorname{Ex}^{!,\mathrm{sm}}_{f,v,K}:
Lu^*Rf^!K
\xrightarrow{\ (Lu^*\gamma_{f,K})^{-1}\ }
Lu^*((Lf^*K)(d)[2d])
\xrightarrow{\ b_{\square,K}\ }
(Lf'^*Lv^*K)(d)[2d]
\xrightarrow{\ \gamma_{f',Lv^*K}\ }
Rf'^!Lv^*K.
$$
This notation specifies the purity composite, rather than denoting a right-adjoint mate of compact-support base change.
